citation: Creamer, Winifred; Ruiz Rubio, Alvaro; Perales Munguía, Manuel F.; Haas, Jonathan. 2013. “The Fortaleza Valley, Peru: Archaeological Investigation of Late Archaic Sites (3000–1800 BC).” Fieldiana Anthropology 2013 (44): 1–108. DOI 10.3158/0071-4739-44.0.1.
notes: Fieldiana Anthropology field report. 2003–2004 testing at six Fortaleza Valley sites (Porvenir, Caballete, Cerro Blanco 1–2, Huaricanga, Shaura); 80 radiocarbon samples; occupation Late Archaic 3000–1800 BC; stepped pyramids, sunken circular plazas, huancas (upright monoliths); shicra (fiber bags) in monumental construction; U-shaped layouts noted at sites such as Caballete and Porvenir.
